Wellcon Animal Health is the innovative research based company determined to provide animal health products for livestock, poultry, pets & aquaculture animals.

Our innovative quality products are designed for well-being of animal kind. Our ultimate goal is to provide veterinary solutions by cutting edge produce to support the veterinarian & livestock producers.

We ensure our product fulfills our customers on the basis of efficiency, safety & quality standards.

Our core strength lies in manufacturing innovative & quality products to ensure Animal Wellness.
